entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and it's completely broken.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A technical fault? Of course it is! It's defective! The heart rate is never accurate, and it absolutely won't sync with the app. The main features are not working at all! I'm not paying for something that's broken right out of the box.

I understand your frustration completely. Let me just pull up your account information. I see your order here. Before we discuss a return, can we quickly try to troubleshoot? Sometimes a simple restart can fix the issue when a device won't sync.

Are you kidding me?! I'm not your tech support! I've tried everything. I want my money back. This is unacceptable. Put your manager on the phone right now. I swear I will leave a review on every single website about this.
Sir, there's no need for a manager, I assure you I can resolve this for you. I just need to follow procedure. Let me review the return policy for your order. One moment.

Okay, I have your details here. I can see the VeloBand was delivered 42 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that window, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for this defective item.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what you should have said from the start. Fine. Do it.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued.
Fine. Whatever. Just make sure I get my money back.
You will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
